headlines.title: Union Pacific Chief Financial Officer Jennifer Hamann to Retire After 35 Years of Service
headlines.summary: OMAHA, Neb., October 16, 2026--Union Pacific Railroad today announced Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Jennifer Hamann will retire in early 2027, concluding a remarkable 35-year career that helped shape the railroad through decades of growth, transformation and industry leadership.

headlines.title: 3 Dividend Stocks With Economic Moats That Are Almost Impossible to Cross
headlines.summary: Building a second freight network across the United States would take over a century and cost more than any rival could justify, and that physical impossibility quietly funds the dividends three railroad giants pay their shareholders. Here is what separates the one growing fastest from the one still frozen in place.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
